_comment: Adapter outcome contract for the wake coordinator. For the full wake-state transition matrix, see tests/fixtures/relay_wake/contract.json.

admitted.description: Correlated admission event received; delivery complete.

triggered.description: Runtime accepted request; await admission callback within deadline.

unavailable.description: Session closed, not found, or capability gone; immediate fallback.

rejected.description: Permanent failure (permission, version, policy); fallback with reason.

ambiguous.description: Transport accepted but admission unconfirmed; wait for deadline then fallback.
ambiguous.note: No retry unless runtime proves supplied ID is idempotent.

invariants: Natural-turn claim is blocked while wake_state is queued, triggering, or triggered.
Message expiry is terminal for all non-admitted states; late callbacks fail.
Wake callback token is single-use, 256-bit, stored only as a hash.
Session reopen creates a new adapter generation; old-generation callbacks are rejected.
Adapter must not import generic relay coordinator types.
Busy delivery never steers text into the active human-owned turn.
